title: Pelorus hardware report intake record, version 1
description: One tracked file under docs/hardware-reports/: the tester's report.json plus who to credit. scripts/hardware-reports/check-reports.py checks it with the keyword subset that tools/tester/pelorus_tester_report.py implements.

credit.description: Name or handle to credit. Empty or absent: recorded as anonymous. No e-mail address.

machine.description: Free text, for example 'Ryzen 7 7840U with Radeon 780M, Linux 6.12'.

report.description: The unchanged report.json; validated with tools/tester/report.schema.json.
